Bharat Gears Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015'.:We refer to our letter dated April 16, 2026 made pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (the "Regulations").Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the Regulations  we hereby inform you that Mr. Surinder Paul Kanwar, Chairman and Managing Director of the Company, has intimated the Company that the appeal dated 15.04.2026 filed by him under Section 11 of the Passports Act, 1967, against the revocation of his passport, has been dismissed by an Order dated July 23, 2026 passed by the Joint Secretary (PSP) & Chief Passport Officer (CPO), Ministry of External Affairs, which was received by him on July 29, 2026. Mr. Kanwar has further informed the Company that the said appeal has been disposed of without providing him any opportunity of representing his case, which is contrary to the proviso to Section 11(5) of the Passports Act, 1967, which mandates that a reasonable opportunity has to be given before disposing of the appeal. Accordingly, he is in the process taking appropriate steps for filing a rectification/clarificatory/appropriate application viz. the said order.Mr. Kanwar has also assured that at every juncture, he remains fully mindful of his fiduciary duties and will continue to keep the Board promptly informed of any material developments and advised that the statutory authorities be informed accordingly in a fair and transparent manner.The Company will keep you informed of any material developments in this matter, as and when required, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.You are requested to kindly take the same on record.

Bharat Gears Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015'.This is to inform you that on 26th May, 2026, the Company became aware that certain unpublished price sensitive information ( UPSI ) relating to the Company was shared/disclosed by the Joint Managing Director of the Company to certain third parties and his personal lawyer Ms. Prerna Mahajan, who are not a part of the Board of Directors of the Company. The said information pertained to the draft annual financial results and financial statements of the Company for the quarter and year ended 31st March, 2026.The meeting of Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled to be held on 30th May, 2026 to consider and approve the annual financial results and financial statements for the quarter and year ended 31st March, 2026, in accordance with the applicable law and the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( LODR Regulations ).The aforesaid sharing of UPSI by the JMD constitutes a violation of Code of Conduct for Prevention of Insider Trading and the Company shall take such actions as may be considered appropriate based on the outcome of the inquiry and/or as may be required pursuant to applicable law, regulatory directions or directions of competent authorities.The Company has ensured by sending a notice to the advocate that the UPSI information shared with them by the Joint Managing Director shall not be disclosed or disseminated to any other person except as may be permitted under the SEBI Regulations & Company s Policy.You are requested to kindly take the same on record.

Bharat Gears Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015'. We refer to our letter dated January 23, 2026 wherein, pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (the Regulations), we informed you that at the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company held on January 23, 2026, the Board considered the legal opinion and opined that the power to determine the citizenship status of Mr. Surinder Paul Kanwar, Chairman and Managing Director of the Company vests exclusively with the Central Government and, accordingly, concluded that until any direction or order is issued by the Central Government in respect of his citizenship status, the citizenship status of Mr. Surinder Paul Kanwar, Chairman and Managing Director of the Company, continues to remain unchanged and he shall be regarded as a citizen of India. Thus, he shall continue to discharge his responsibilities as Chairman and Managing Director.This is to further inform you that the Board members have received an intimation from Mr. Surinder Paul Kanwar, Chairman and Managing Director of the Company vide his e-mail dated April 16, 2026 that he has received a communication from the Regional Passport Office regarding the revocation of his passport, with a right of appeal to the Central Passport Office. Acting on legal advice, he has promptly filed an appeal on April 15, 2026 before the competent authority at the Central Passport Office, seeking (i) a stay of the revocation during the pendency of the appeal and (ii) quashing of the revocation order.Mr. Kanwar has further clarified that as he concludes that the Central Passport Office is the authority empowered to adjudicate the revocation, he has immediately informed the Board at this substantive juncture i.e., upon filing the appeal.Mr. Kanwar has reiterated that the determination of his citizenship status lies exclusively with the Central Government (Ministry of Home Affairs) and the Board of Directors of the Company duly noted this position at its meeting held on January 23, 2026, after considering the independent legal opinion. Separately, he has also written to the Secretaries of the Ministry of Home Affairs and the Ministry of External Affairs vide his letter dated March 30, 2026 (through Speed Post on April 04, 2026), seeking clarification on his citizenship status, to which reply is still awaited.Mr. Kanwar has also assured that he remains fully mindful of his fiduciary duties and will continue to keep the Board promptly informed of any material developments and advised that the statutory authorities be informed accordingly in a fair and transparent manner.The Company will keep you informed of any material developments in this matter, as and when required, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.You are requested to kindly take the same on record.

Bharat Gears Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Intimation under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015Ref: Our Letter dated November 14, 2025 We refer to our letter dated November 14, 2025 wherein, pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (the Regulations), we informed you that at the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company held on November 14, 2025, the Board advised the management to obtain a comprehensive independent legal opinion on the citizenship status of Mr. Surinder Paul Kanwar, Chairman and Managing Director of the Company, and decided that the Board would consider the appropriate course of action upon receipt of the legal opinion.Subsequent to that disclosure, and in accordance with Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the Regulations, we hereby inform you that, in continuation of the aforesaid directions of the Board of Directors, a comprehensive legal opinion on the matter has been obtained and placed before the Board of Directors of the Company in its meeting held on January 23, 2026 for review and to form an opinion and issue further directions, if any.We hereby inform you that the Board, in its aforesaid meeting, considered the said legal opinion and opined that the power to determine the citizenship status of Mr. Surinder Paul Kanwar, Chairman and Managing Director of the Company vests exclusively with the Central Government and, accordingly, concluded that until any direction or order is issued by the Central Government in respect of his citizenship status, the citizenship status of Mr. Surinder Paul Kanwar, Chairman and Managing Director of the Company, continues to remain unchanged and he shall be regarded as a citizen of India. Thus, he shall continue to discharge his responsibilities as Chairman and Managing Director.The Company will keep you informed of any material developments in this matter, as and when required, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.You are requested to kindly take the same on record.

Bharat Gears Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Mr Hitendra Mishra as Chief Executive Officer of the company w.e.f.
